description:
A single OpenSearch query DSL clause. Exactly one of the properties below may be set — the set property names the clause kind. See query vs. filter context and term-level vs. full-text queries.

The field-keyed leaf clauses (match, term, range, ...) are maps whose key is the column name and whose value is the per-field options object — only the long form is accepted (e.g. {"match":{"title":{"query":"x"}}}, not the {"match":{"title":"x"}} shorthand). The compound clauses (bool, dis_max, ...) nest further Query DSL clauses recursively.

match.description: A match full-text clause. Map of column name to its match options.

match_phrase.description: A match_phrase clause. Map of column name to its phrase options.

match_phrase_prefix.description: A match_phrase_prefix clause. Map of column name to its options.

match_bool_prefix.description: A match_bool_prefix clause. Map of column name to its options.

term.description: A term term-level clause. Map of column name to its term options.

range.description: A range term-level clause. Map of column name to its range bounds.

prefix.description: A prefix term-level clause. Map of column name to its prefix options.

wildcard.description: A wildcard term-level clause. Map of column name to its wildcard options.

fuzzy.description: A fuzzy term-level clause. Map of column name to its fuzzy options.

terms.description: A terms term-level clause (matches any of several exact values). Field-keyed: {"terms":{"<column>":[v1, v2], "boost":1.0}}. The cross-index terms-lookup form is rejected. Carried as an opaque object because the field name is itself a key and the values are an array of polymorphic scalars; the same allowlist is enforced server-side.

bool.name: BoolQuery
bool.description: A bool compound clause — combines sub-clauses with boolean logic.

must.description: Sub-clauses that must all match (scored). Logical AND.

must_not.description: Sub-clauses that must not match (filter context, not scored).

filter.description: Sub-clauses that must all match in filter context (not scored).

minimum_should_match.description: Optional. How many should clauses must match. An integer or a percentage / formula string.

adjust_pure_negative.description: Optional. Whether to automatically add a match_all when only negative clauses are present. Default true.

boost.description: Optional. Multiplier for the relevance score of this clause. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.

dis_max.name: DisMaxQuery
dis_max.description: A dis_max compound clause. A document matches if any sub-clause matches; its score is the best single sub-clause score plus tie_breaker times the rest.

tie_breaker.description: Optional. Weight (0–1) applied to the scores of the non-best matching clauses. Default 0.0.

boost.description: Optional. Multiplier for the relevance score of this clause. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.

constant_score.name: ConstantScoreQuery
constant_score.description: A constant_score compound clause. Wraps a filter and assigns every matching document the same score (boost).

filter.description: Required. The clause evaluated in filter context.

boost.description: Optional. The constant score assigned to every matching document. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.

boosting.name: BoostingQuery
boosting.description: A boosting compound clause. Returns documents matching positive, demoting those that also match negative by negative_boost.

positive.description: Required. The clause documents must match.

negative.description: Required. The clause whose matches are demoted.

negative_boost.description: Required. Multiplier (0–1) applied to the score of documents that also match negative.

boost.description: Optional. Multiplier for the relevance score of this clause. Default 1.0.

_name.description: Optional. Label echoed back in matched-queries metadata.
